title: 2009 AMC 10A Problem 6
statement: A circle of radius \(2\) is inscribed in a semicircle, as shown. The area inside the semicircle but outside the circle is shaded. What fraction of the semicircle’s area is shaded?

solutions.text:
The inscribed circle rests on the diameter and is tangent to the arc, so the semicircle has radius \(4.\) Its area is \[\dfrac12 \pi (4)^2 = 8\pi.\]

The circle’s area is \(\pi(2)^2 = 4\pi,\) so the shaded area is \(8\pi - 4\pi = 4\pi.\)

The shaded fraction is \(\dfrac{4\pi}{8\pi} = \dfrac12.\)

Thus, the correct answer is A.
hints: The circle sits on the diameter and touches the arc, so the semicircle has radius \(4\)
